head: 9 new health and fitness apps climbing the App Store this week
dek: These health and fitness apps came out in the last 60 days and rose into the US App Store's Health & Fitness charts this week, from lifting logs and a calorie tracker to Apple Watch tools for naps, counting and blood oxygen.
where: iPhone (several also Apple Watch), US App Store paid Health & Fitness chart this week
means: If you track workouts, food or sleep, these are new paid apps people in the US are buying, several of them one-time purchases.
todo: Check each App Store page for what it needs: Glucose Relay needs a LibreLinkUp account that follows your FreeStyle Libre sensor, and Crown Counter and Nappuccino are built for Apple Watch.

list.name: Setomi
list.what: A lifting log that imports your plan from a PDF, spreadsheet, photo or note, on iPhone and Apple Watch.

list.name: Cheiron
list.what: Tracks a bodybuilder's food, training, supplements, weight and cardio in one app.

list.name: Fituous
list.what: A calorie and nutrition tracker with macros, water, fasting and weight, kept on your device.

list.name: Glucose Relay
list.what: Copies FreeStyle Libre glucose readings into Apple Health automatically through LibreLinkUp.

list.name: PulseO2: Blood Oxygen Tracker
list.what: Shows your Apple Watch blood oxygen readings on your watch face and iPhone.

list.name: Circles: Workout Log
list.what: A workout log with templates, your last weights on every set and a rest timer.

list.name: DakiniSpace
list.what: Plays slowly changing drones made from real gongs over nature sounds, for headphones or speakers.

list.name: Crown Counter: Tally Clicker
list.what: Turns your Apple Watch into a tally counter you use with the Digital Crown.

list.name: Nappuccino: Coffee & Power Nap
list.what: A nap timer for Apple Watch that starts counting when you fall asleep, with a coffee nap mode.
